scientific_integrity: Proof by exact finite-group character orthogonality. Finite exact-arithmetic checks corroborate and do not establish the all-dimensional conclusion. No claim of independent audit, broad privacy guarantee, or proof of global novelty.
scientific_limitations: Real normalized global Sylvester-Hadamard matrix; contiguous dyadic row blocks; independent uniform block draws with replacement; fixed coordinate subspaces. title: Exact dyadic-residue spectra for contiguous-block Walsh sketches
